events.title: Sunday Celebration & Worship Service
events.description: Join us every Sunday morning for an uplifting worship experience, transformative biblical message by Pastor Duncan Kirya, and warm fellowship.

events.title: Midweek Prayer & Teaching Altar
events.description: A dedicated gathering of intercessory prayer, worship, and practical biblical teaching for spiritual growth.

events.title: Christ Formed Foundation Community Outreach
events.description: Providing food packages, practical encouragement, and social assistance to older community members and single mothers.

sermons.title: PRAISE AND WORSHIP MOMENT
sermons.speaker: Pastor Valence
sermons.description:
John 4:23–24 (KJV)
“But the hour cometh, and now is, when the true worshippers shall worship the Father in spirit and in truth: for the Father seeketh such to worship him.
God is a Spirit: and they that worship him must worship him in spirit and in truth.”

sermons.title: BAPTISM
sermons.speaker: Pastor Duncan Kirya
sermons.description:
“Go ye therefore, and teach all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Ghost.”
— Matthew 28:19 (KJV)

sermons.title: Formed in Christ: Walking in Vision & Faith
sermons.speaker: Pastor Duncan Kirya
sermons.description: Founder Pastor Duncan Kirya shares how yielding our lives to Christ forms His divine character, purpose, and restoration within us.

sermons.title: Unwavering Trust in Seasons of Growth
sermons.speaker: Pastor Valence
sermons.description: Assistant Pastor Valence encourages believers to stay steadfast in faith, reflecting on how God leads small beginnings into abundant blessings.

ministries.name: Christ Formed Foundation
ministries.description: Our community-support initiative dedicated to helping older people and single mothers facing financial, social, and practical challenges with love, care, and practical support.

ministries.name: Worship & Altar Fellowship
ministries.description: Leading the church into deep spiritual encounters, prayer, and acoustic & vocal worship.

ministries.name: Discipleship & Teaching Ministry
ministries.description: Equipping believers through in-depth scripture study, prayer training, and practical Christian living.

announcements.title: Christ Formed Foundation Support Drive
announcements.content: We invite all members and partners to join hands with the Christ Formed Foundation as we prepare gift packages and assistance for older people and single mothers in Kibiri.

announcements.title: Welcome to Our Sanctuary in Kibiri, near Munyonyo
announcements.content: Join us this Sunday as we gather to seek God, receive spiritual encouragement, and experience healing and restoration in Christ.

pastors.name: Pastor Duncan Kirya
pastors.title: Founder & Pastor
pastors.bio: Founder of Christ Formed Church International. Birthed the ministry on 23rd March 2019 following a vision to reach and serve God's people with faith, love, and spiritual restoration.

pastors.name: Pastor Valence
pastors.title: Assistant Pastor
pastors.bio: Serves alongside Pastor Duncan in spiritual shepherding, preaching, prayer ministry, and guiding believers into mature faith.

pastors.name: Miss Flavia
pastors.title: Administrator
pastors.bio: Oversees church operations, foundation initiatives, and administrative coordination, ensuring seamless ministry service to the community.

pastors.name: Mrs. Christine Kirya
pastors.title: Assistant
pastors.bio: Supports pastoral shepherding, hospitality, and women's fellowship, passionate about building strong Christian families and serving vulnerable members.

prayers.name: Community Member
prayers.request: Praying for God's blessings upon the Christ Formed Foundation as we serve single mothers and elderly community members.
